# Audio Notes

Audio Notes is a personal transcription app: upload a recording, get a
transcript (Gnani Batch STT, with per-segment timestamps) and an LLM summary
(Groq, English-first). Stack: Next.js 16, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Procrastinate
background jobs, Cloudflare R2 object storage, one EC2 instance behind nginx.

- App (login required): http://3.111.18.213/
- How the system works: http://3.111.18.213/architecture
- API (authenticated, JWT): http://3.111.18.213/api
- Liveness: http://3.111.18.213/health

## Notes

- Every route except /health requires a Better Auth session.
- Transcripts keep per-segment start/end times; summaries are generated from
  an English translation of the transcript.
- Uploads cap at 10MB: wav, mp3, m4a, flac, ogg, webm.
